characters.summary: Hawkeye is an expert marksman, master archer, and close-quarters combatant who relies on tactical precision, advanced trick arrows, and peak human conditioning rather than superhuman abilities.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to superhuman physical attacks due to ordinary human biology
Limited supply of ammunition and specialized arrows
mobility: Utilization of standard vehicles and grappling lines
limitations: Relies on physical endurance and finite ammunition supply

sources.supports: General background, weapons, and tactical role in the Avengers.
Abilities, trick arrows, and combat feats across MCU films and series.

feats.claim: Successfully defended a position against an army of Chitauri using standard and trick arrows.
Fought evenly against Black Widow during close-quarters combat.

notableResults.note: Fought while under mind control by Loki, later freed.

campaignTags.claim: Uses specialized trick arrows with various tactical effects.

characters.summary: Heimdall is an almighty Asgardian sentry possessing superhuman physical attributes, enhanced sensory perception capable of viewing trillions of souls across the cosmos, and mastery of the Hofund sword.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to severe physical trauma from exceptionally powerful entities
Senses can be obscured by powerful concealment magic

sources.supports: Heimdall's sensory powers, Asgardian physiology, and combat feats.

feats.claim: Perceived invisible Dark Elves infiltrating Asgard.
Killed multiple Frost Giants during the raid on Jotunheim.

notableResults.note: Killed after attempting an ambush on Thanos.

conditional.dependsOn: Access to Hofund and connection to the Observatory

campaignTags.claim: Wields mystical perception and controls the Bifrost bridge.
Can summon the Bifrost to transport individuals across space.

characters.summary: Hela is the Asgardian Goddess of Death, possessing immense physical strength, near-limitless generation of Necrosword weapons, self-regeneration linked to Asgard, and mastery over dark magic.
weaknesses: Power diminishes significantly if separated from Asgard for extended periods
limitations: Power draws directly from the existence of Asgard

sources.supports: Hela's powers, weapons, Necrosword creation, and Asgardian dependency.

feats.claim: Caught and crushed Thor's enchanted hammer Mjolnir with one hand.
Slaughtered the entire Valkyrie army single-handedly.

notableResults.note: Easily overpowered Thor and gouged out his eye.

campaignTags.claim: Commands dark Asgardian magic to manifest weapons and raise the dead.
Demonstrates the ability to levitate and fly during combat.

characters.summary: Hercules is an Olympian warrior introduced in post-credits media, possessing mythological divine strength, durability, and proficiency with ancient weaponry.
weaknesses: Not established in current cinematic appearances

sources.supports: Hercules' introduction and divine background in the MCU.

feats.claim: Tasked by Zeus to hunt down Thor and prove the superiority of Olympian gods.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses divine Olympian stature and vast physical strength.

characters.summary: Howard Stark is a brilliant industrialist, scientist, and engineer who relies on his intellect, advanced conventional weaponry, and technological inventions rather than direct combat skills.
weaknesses: Vulnerable human biology with no superhuman defensive capabilities

sources.supports: Howard Stark's background as an inventor and scientist.

feats.claim: Assisted in discovering a new chemical element using holographic projection models.

campaignTags.claim: Invented numerous advanced technologies and contributed to early arc reactor designs.
Master of advanced mid-20th-century technology and experimental physics.

characters.summary: Hulk is the massive, gamma-mutated alter ego of Bruce Banner who relies on extreme brute strength, shockwave thunderclaps, and unyielding rage that increases his power during combat.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to psychological calming techniques (like Natasha Romanoff's lullaby)
Susceptible to powerful neurotoxins or extreme electrical shock
limitations: Transforms back into Bruce Banner when calm or exhausted

sources.supports: General overview of Hulk's strength, origin, and appearances in the MCU.
Hulk's feats, abilities, and combat style.

feats.claim: Stopped a leviathan Chitauri warship with a single punch.
Carried the collapsed Avengers facility rubble off trapped heroes.

notableResults.note: Overpowered in a brief hand-to-hand brawl.

campaignTags.claim: Stands well over 8 feet tall with enormous muscular mass.
Possesses a rapid regenerative healing factor.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to emotional manipulation or holographic triggers (like Natasha's video message)

campaignTags.claim: Maintains a massive muscular giant stature.
